At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.37 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: Amity Hill Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 13 curves in 4.5 miles.
From 780 to 920 ft, with 713 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
6 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 88°F.
